items.title: PTI wire: FIR against Das, Ranka over Jantar Mantar breach also cites breach of the one-year peace bond
items.summary: PTI wire (via The Sen Times, syndicated on Ghanamma, Inshorts, NewsPoint) reports a police source saying the FIR registered Tuesday against Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka and other CJP members for allegedly trespassing at the de-notified Jantar Mantar includes sections for breach of the peace bond they signed on Oct 11 (Rs 50,000 surety, one-year peace-and-good-behaviour condition). Officers said the detained protesters were taken to Jaffarpur Kalan PS (Dwarka district); the outfit says 11 of its members were detained. Dipke framed the breach as 'reclaiming' Jantar Mantar. The peace-bond-breach angle is new substance beyond the earlier single-sourced trespass-FIR report — it directly puts the Oct 11 bond condition in play, opening the door to possible judicial-custody proceedings for the trio.
